parameter.name: ORACLE_REF_CURSOR
parameter.description: Tham số mặc định cho cursor khi thực hiện với procedure, package

excel_template.queryString: select 'G01024_025.2-TTGS' STR1,PO_MASBV STR2,PO_MASBV STR3, to_char(sysdate,'DDMMYYYY') STR4, 'QUANGND' STR5, 'ID DUYET' STR6 from dmpos where po_ma= $P{PARA_MAPGD}

SELECT REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR11)),'.',',') STR11, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR22)),'.',',') STR22, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR11)+SUM(STR22)),'.',',') STR33, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR44)),'.',',') STR44, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR55)),'.',',') STR55, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR66)),'.',',') STR66, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR55)+SUM(STR66)),'.',',') STR77, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(STR88)),'.',',') STR88 FROM (SELECT ROUND(SUM(NVL((D1), 0))/1000000,1) STR11, ROUND(SUM(NVL((D2), 0))/1000000,1) STR22, ROUND(SUM(NVL((D3), 0))/1000000,1) STR33, ROUND(SUM(NVL((D4), 0))/1000000,1) STR44, ROUND(SUM(NVL((D5), 0))/1000000,1) STR55, ROUND(SUM(NVL((D6), 0))/1000000,1) STR66, ROUND(SUM(NVL((D7), 0))/1000000,1) STR77, ROUND(SUM(NVL((D8), 0))/1000000,1) STR88 FROM SBV_DULIEU WHERE KHOA = 'SBV_0252_TTGS' AND NGAYBC = $P{PARA_NGAYBC} AND DECODE(VBSP_PUBLIC_FUNCTION.F_GET_REPORT_GRADE($P{PARA_MAPGD},$P{PARA_TONGHOP}),1,MAPGD,2,MACN,3,'1')= (CASE WHEN VBSP_PUBLIC_FUNCTION.F_GET_REPORT_GRADE($P{PARA_MAPGD},$P{PARA_TONGHOP}) = 3 THEN '1' ELSE $P{PARA_MAPGD} END) GROUP BY MA,TEN,NGAYBC ORDER BY MA )
